Name: More Monsters Expanded
Author: KringleKiller
Description:
[size=4][b][u]Description[/u][/b][/size]
I often found myself wishing I had more monsters to fight when grinding mastery or searching for crafting/quest items. The best mod I found to help with this problem was [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30032]More Monsters[/url] created by [b]HongAndNineFish[/b] and uploaded by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ReddishLunar]ReddishLunar[/url]. While that mod usually worked despite it's age, there was no GMCM support and no support for locations added by other mods. 

More Monster Expanded is a reworked and improved take on the original. It has GMCM support with fine tuning options to adjust monster spawning in areas both vanilla, and many mod originating locations. 

[size=4][b][u]Supported Locations[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]All vanilla locations[/*]
[*]SDV Expanded locations[/*]
[*]SBV locations[/*]
[*]Ridgeside Village locations[/*]
[/list]Most modded locations that use vanilla spawn methods or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url] should be supported.

[b][u][size=4]GMCM Settings and FTM Specific Areas[/size][/u][/b]
Spawn settings for vanilla locations can be changed at any time and will reflect in the game when you enter the mines or decend to the next floor if you're already there.

Most modded locations with have to be changed before you end the day and will not be reflected in the game until a new day starts. This is due to the way most mods utilize FTM, which sets spawn rates when each new day loads. I reccomend you change the settings to what you need right before bed, sleep, explore the mines until your work is done, and set the settings back to baseline before you sleep again. Leaving FTM settings on when not in the mines will cause unnecessary lag and framerate drop. 

[b][color=#ff0000][size=4][u]Warning[/u][/size][/color][/b]
I'm gonna say it once more...[color=#ff0000][b]WARNING![/b][/color] Spawning high volumes of monsters with FTM (farm type manager) will put very high stress on your CPU. Due to the way SDV was made, it cannot make full use of your CPU, and it relies on using a single core to proccess most game loop, logic, and rendering.

I tested and built this mod running a Intel Ultra 9 285k, and experienced severe framerate instability while running fully maxed out FTM spawner GMCM settings. I did not experience this with vanilla locations max spawn settings, FTM locations only.

I [u][b]highly[/b][/u] reccomend you test settings on a lower spawn rate first if adjusting FTM locations (like SBV mines).

[size=4][b][u]Installation instructions[/u][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Install with vortex or unzip into Stardew Valley\Content\Mods[/color]

[size=4][b][u]Requirements[/u][/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]smapi, and FTM for modded location[/color]

[size=4][b][u]Shout outs[/u][/b][/size]
